title: Microsoft Copilot for finance: Purpose-built for the way finance teams work
summary: Discover Microsoft Copilot for finance, purpose-built skills for accounting, capital markets, and broader finance work.

title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
summary: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations. GA date: January CY2027 Preview date: November CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
summary: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles. GA date: October CY2026 Preview date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
summary: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem GA date: April CY2027 Preview date: May CY2025

title: October 2026
